page.text:
# Donate to Alison Proctor for SMUHSD Trustee Area 5!
I’m running for the San Mateo Union High School District Board because I believe every student deserves a high school experience that prepares them for a bright and successful future.
As a mom, Mills High School graduate, and experienced school board trustee, I care deeply about our schools and our community. I want to build on the district’s strengths while continuing to ask how we can better serve every student, especially those who need additional support or greater access to opportunities.
High school should help students discover their strengths, explore what excites them, and prepare for whatever comes next. I want to bring my experience, financial background, and commitment to student achievement, wellness, and equity to the Board to help make that possible for every student.
Report this form
#### Contribution rules
- I am at least eighteen years old.
- I am making this contribution with my own personal credit card and not with a corporate or business credit card or a card issued to another person.
- This contribution is made from my own funds, and funds are not being provided to me by another person or entity for the purpose of making this contribution.
- I am a U.S. citizen or lawfully admitted permanent resident (i.e., green card holder).
Americans living abroad may only contribute to political entities if they have a verified U.S. passport in their Express account. By proceeding with this transaction, you agree to ActBlue's terms & conditions.
